about.title: About KrishiDirect AI
about.problem: Small and marginal farmers often sell through several layers of intermediaries, with little visibility of prices elsewhere and limited bargaining power. Perishable produce makes this worse: farmers must sell fast, and buyers are hard to reach.
about.problem2: Buyers — retailers, hotels, wholesalers and cooperatives — likewise struggle to find fresh produce with clear quantity, grade and harvest information.
about.mission: Make direct market access simple: let farmers list produce in their own language, see fair reference prices, receive offers and coordinate orders — with transparency about what is real and what is sample data.
about.ps: Direct Market-Access Platform for Marginal Farmers
about.f_a_d: Farmers list crops with quantity, grade, harvest date and location.
about.f_b_d: Buyers propose prices; farmers accept, reject or counter with a full history.
about.f_c_d: From confirmation to preparation, pickup/delivery and receipt, with timelines.
about.f_d_d: Reference price trends and comparisons, clearly labelled when they are sample data.
about.f_e_d: English, Kannada, Hindi and Tulu (Tulu pending community review).
about.f_f_d: Rule-based buyer–listing matches that explain why each result is suggested.
about.v1_d: Simple flows, local languages and mobile-friendly design for real farming contexts.
about.v2_d: We never present sample prices, weather or verification as real. Every demo section is labelled.
about.v3_d: No public phone numbers, minimal data, and clear control over what is shared.
about.v4_d: Highlight the lowest price without implying it is the best, and keep negotiations visible to both parties.
about.honestH: What this demo is — and is not
about.h1: It is a working end-to-end prototype with persisted sample data.
about.h2: It is not connected to live market data, payment providers, logistics partners or identity verification.
about.h3: Sample farmers, buyers and organisations are fictional.
about.h4: Listing locations are district-level examples, not verified places.
about.who: We welcome feedback from farmers, FPOs, buyers and agri-tech practitioners — especially native speakers who can review the Kannada, Hindi and Tulu translations.

p: KrishiDirect AI (“we”, “the platform”) is a demonstration marketplace that connects farmers and buyers. This policy explains what information the demo handles and how it is used.
We aim to follow data-minimisation principles consistent with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This policy is not legal advice.
Listing information you enter (crop, quantity, price, district, village, description, photos).
Demo activity: offers, counteroffers, orders, enquiry messages and notifications created while you use the app.
Contact-form submissions (name, e-mail, message).
Preferences stored in your browser (language, theme, saved crops, comparison list, recent searches, selected demo identity).
We do not collect real payment details, government identity numbers, precise GPS location or contact-book data.
Phone numbers and e-mail addresses of farmers and buyers are never displayed publicly. Communication happens through in-app enquiries.
To show listings, run offers and demo orders, send in-app notifications, and respond to contact messages.
We do not sell personal information and do not use it for advertising.
The app uses your browser’s local storage for preferences. It does not use advertising or analytics cookies.
Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which means your browser contacts Google when pages load. You may self-host fonts in your own deployment.
Data in this demo is stored on the server in a simple file and can be reset at any time from Demo Mode. Do not enter real personal or sensitive information.
Contact messages are retained until the demo data is reset or deleted by the operator.
You can clear saved preferences by clearing your browser’s site data, delete your own listings, and ask us to delete a contact message.
Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction or erasure of personal data we hold about you.
The platform is intended for adults engaged in agriculture and trade and is not directed at children.
We use reasonable safeguards such as input validation and ownership checks. The demo uses sample identities rather than real authentication, so it must not be used for confidential data.
We may update this policy as the platform evolves and will change the date above. Please use the contact page for privacy questions.
By using KrishiDirect AI you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

KrishiDirect AI is a demonstration platform that lets users create sample listings, send offers and place Demo Orders. It is not a licensed trading venue, broker, commission agent or payment provider.
Unless the operator states otherwise, all people, organisations, prices and activity shown are simulated.
No real payment is processed. A Demo Order or accepted offer is a simulated record and does not create a legally binding sale in this demo.
If the platform is later used for real trade, buyers and sellers remain responsible for agreeing payment, delivery and quality terms directly.
Provide accurate information about produce, quantity, grade, harvest date and organic claims. Organic status is a declaration by the seller and is not verified by the platform.
Do not post unlawful, misleading or harmful content, or content that includes personal contact details of others.
Do not attempt to access other users’ data, disrupt the service or misuse automated tools.
Price, weather and market information is sample data unless a section explicitly says otherwise. It is for illustration, not financial or agronomic advice.
Recommendations use transparent rules and do not guarantee a good match, quality or profit. The assistant never guarantees yields, profits, disease diagnoses or future prices.
You keep ownership of content you submit and give the platform permission to display it for the purpose of operating the service.
The platform’s design, code and branding remain the property of their owners.
We may remove listings or restrict access that breach these terms or harm other users.
The service is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law we are not liable for losses arising from reliance on sample data or from dealings between users.
These terms are intended to be governed by the laws of India. Disputes would be subject to the courts at the operator’s registered location, to be specified before any commercial launch.
We may update these terms and will change the date above when we do. Please use the contact page with any questions.

start.a: The app runs with sample farmers, buyers, listings and prices. Use the identity menu (top right) to switch between a demo farmer and a demo buyer.

start.q: How do I change the language?
start.a: Use the language selector in the top bar. Your choice is remembered. Tulu text is pending review and falls back to Kannada or English.

selling.q: How do I list my harvest?
selling.a: Switch to a demo farmer, choose Sell Harvest and complete the four steps. You can save a draft or publish immediately.

selling.q: Can I pause or remove a listing?
selling.a: Yes. From your Farmer Dashboard you can pause, resume, mark as sold, edit or delete a listing. Listings with open orders cannot be deleted.

selling.q: Are my phone number and address shown?
selling.a: No. Buyers contact you through in-app enquiries or offers. Only district and village/market area are shown.

buying.q: How do I make an offer?
buying.a: Open a listing, choose Send offer, enter quantity and your price. The farmer can accept, reject or counter.

buying.q: What are the minimum order and stock checks?
buying.a: Your quantity must be at least the minimum order and no more than the available stock. These checks run in your browser and again on the server.

orders.a: No. Orders are Demo Orders and no payment is processed.

orders.q: When can an order be cancelled?
orders.a: A buyer may cancel before the farmer has started preparing it. A farmer may reject a newly placed order. Stock is restored.
Open offers expire after 72 hours without a response.

data.a: No. Price Insights uses generated sample data and is labelled “Demo Data — Not Live Market Prices”.
Open Demo Mode & Reset from the More menu and choose Reset demo data.
